description: Vendor-host batch acceptance: viability is enforced in CI; throughput is advisory only.

viability.notes: At least one sweep row must show compiled batch within 2% of sequential microbatch on CPU. Enforced by reference-authority and vendor-ci-moreau.

throughput_advisory.notes: Tracked in batch_solve_report; does not fail CI. Do not market universal batch speedup until this tier is met on representative scenarios.
